recap.analyst:
Coloso Ciudad beat Lombardia Nord 2-1. On expected goals it finished 0.36–0.36: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Lombardia Nord had 55% of the ball. Pass completion COL 79% (122/154), LOM 84% (185/221). Shots 3–4, on target 2–1.

Coloso Ciudad started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Lombardia Nord in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: LOM to 4-2-3-1 at 69' (chasing the game); COL to 5-4-1 at 86' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 23': Coloso Ciudad levelled the match through Z. Bauer. Score now COL 1-1 LOM.

By the numbers: D. Diallo completed the most passes (35); J. Alves hit the top speed (33.3 km/h); B. Ekström covered the most ground (6.01 km, a 16.7 km per-90 pace); D. Diallo won the most challenges (13).

Discipline: fouls 2–2, yellows 2–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: overcast, 22°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Estadio Coloso, Mexico City. D. Yilmaz broke the deadlock in the 16th minute. Z. Bauer struck in the 23rd for Coloso Ciudad. T. Dalgaard struck in the 31st for Coloso Ciudad. Lombardia Nord pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 69th minute, but Coloso Ciudad held firm. The hero: Z. Bauer, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Coloso Ciudad celebrate in front of their fans.
